FAQs

items.q: Do you remove all types of freezers?
a: Yes, we remove all types, including upright, chest, and residential freezers. No matter the size or style, we can haul it away safely.

items.q: Will you disconnect my freezer before taking it?
a: Absolutely. Our team will safely disconnect and prepare your freezer for removal at no extra charge. Just ensure it’s emptied beforehand.

items.q: How much does freezer removal cost?
a: Prices depend on size and location, but we provide free upfront quotes with no hidden fees. Contact us for an instant estimate.

items.q: What areas do you serve for freezer removal?
a: We serve all of the Greater Toronto Area, including Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, and surrounding neighborhoods.

items.q: Do you recycle or donate old freezers?
a: Yes. We recycle all usable materials and donate working units to charities when possible. Nothing goes to landfills unnecessarily.

items.q: Can I schedule a same-day freezer pickup?
a: Yes, we often offer same-day service.
, and we’ll arrange a pickup at your earliest convenience.

items.q: Do I need to defrost my freezer before removal?
a: Please defrost and empty it beforehand. Our team will handle everything else, including disconnection and transport.

items.q: Will you remove a freezer from my basement or upper floor?
a: Yes, we safely remove freezers from basements, high-rises, and tight spaces. No location is too difficult for our experienced team.
